claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted virtual-asset transfer above the de-minimis threshold MUST evidence complete originator and beneficiary information before execution. Incomplete data refuses the transfer at the action-admissibility gate.
Every transfer to a counterparty VASP MUST evidence counterparty due diligence. Unverified counterparty VASPs refuse the transfer and route to the compliance owner.
Every transfer decision MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable Evidence Pack binding the sanctions-screening result, compliance-owner identity, and Authority Finality outcome.
Every transfer to a jurisdiction that has not yet implemented the Travel Rule (sunrise issue) MUST obtain compliance-owner approval. Unapproved sunrise transfers are refused and routed dual-channel.
